# Pre-PR backup-fs fixture

`legacy-format1.tar.gz` is generated by the production format-1 implementation at `c7ee6171d7be310a5f030527bfe96c0d8733225a`, the base before this PR. Migration consumes these bytes rather than serializing historical structs with the changed implementation.

The password is `password`. Root inode 1 is followed by inode 2 (`frozen-inline`), inode 3 (12,000 bytes of `0x42`, UID 123/GID 456/mode `06751`, xattr `user.fixture=original`), and inode 4 (four 1 MiB chunks of `0x31`). The fixture also contains packed record 42 (`packed bytes`), unreferenced sample blobs, and an authentic version-1 index checkpoint matching its segment inventory.

This format has no named snapshots or versioned objects. Snapshot tests create recovery points only after upgrading to the final format.

Regenerate in a build cache:

```sh
helix-build --output backup-fs-format1-fixture.tar.gz -- bash projects/start-os/backup-fs/testdata/generate.sh
mv backup-fs-format1-fixture.tar.gz projects/start-os/backup-fs/testdata/legacy-format1.tar.gz
```

The generator compiles the pinned production source, exports the store, and restores the working source on exit. Random encryption nonces make regenerated archives differ byte-for-byte.
